title: Lumen Silentii
style: Early 90s new age downtempo, 96 BPM, slow hypnotic hip-hop breakbeat, deep reverb, monastic male choir chant textures, breathy whispered female vocals, ethereal synth pads, shakuhachi-like breathy flute, mysterious spiritual atmosphere, cinematic and sensual
negativeTags: rock, country, pop punk, aggressive, EDM drop, metal
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Wind and distant bells)
(Whispered) Close your eyes... and listen

[Chant]
Lumen in tenebris
Vox silentii

[Verse 1]
(Whispered)
The candle remembers the dark
The river remembers the stone
What you are searching for
Has always been your own

[Chorus]
Lumen silentii
Light of the silent heart
Lumen silentii
We were never apart

[Verse 2]
(Whispered)
Beneath the noise of the world
A quieter voice will call
Follow the breath inward
And you will find it all

[Chant]
Lumen in tenebris
Vox silentii

[Chorus]
Lumen silentii
Light of the silent heart
Lumen silentii
We were never apart

[Bridge]
(Whispered) Are you listening?
(Whispered) Are you ready?

[Outro]
Lumen... silentii
(Bells fade)
